name: Capfin India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Capfin India Ltd provides loans to corporates and non-corporates
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is registered as a Non Systemically Important Non Deposit taking NBFC and its primary business is to provide loans & advances and finance. Company underwrites, holds and sell shares, debentures, bonds, mortgages, obligations and securities of any kind, issued or guaranteed by any company

cons: Stock is trading at 7.12 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -1.16% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 541 days to 778 days
